critical_code_review_comments: IMPORTANT: The webhook uses user_id from app_user_id field. The app must call Purchases.logIn(userId) with the actual backend user_id (e.g., user_abc123), NOT the apple_user_id. This is correctly documented in server.py.
server.py is now 3644 lines - very large monolith. Consider splitting into modules: auth.py, credits.py, studio.py, webhooks.py
Anti-abuse tracking stores device_id in subscriptions collection. Consider adding index on anti_abuse_device_id for faster lookups.
Trial expiration check in get_user_credits() updates DB when trial expires - this is a side effect in a GET operation. Consider moving to a separate cron job.
seed_data_creation: All test accounts (trial_test_*, abuse_test*, studio_admin_*, studio_member_*, admin_leave_*, admin_self_*) were cleaned up during test runs.
